attackers_goals: Adversaries may use LLM APIs to create malicious payload dynamically. Each payload will be slightly different making detection more complex.
description: An untrusted process contacted an LLM API.
investigative_actions: Investigate the process that contacted the LLM API. Check if this LLM API access is legitimate and expected. Analyze the data potentially sent to the LLM service.
name: Untrusted process contacted LLM API
